caption:
Hospitality runs on daily cash turnover and thin margins, with costs like stock, wages and rent due regardless of a quiet week. Working capital and equipment finance are commonly used to manage these swings and fund fit-outs or kitchen upgrades.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs — understanding hospitality and cafe businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

From fit-outs to seasonal cash-flow swings, hospitality has a distinct financial rhythm that generic finance doesn't always fit well.
